title: Remove the legacy repository clock injection hook
objective: Remove the root-level CI-only usercustomize hook after EM-0010 makes reproducible timestamp semantics explicit in the compiler, so validation no longer mutates Python global clock behavior at interpreter startup.
acceptance: the root-level usercustomize.py hook is absent
CI does not monkeypatch datetime globally at Python interpreter startup
make check proves deterministic output through EM-0010 compiler semantics without an environment-specific clock hook
the accepted repository remains clean after validation
limitations: This task does not redefine generated_at semantics; EM-0010 owns that implementation.
This task must not be implemented before EM-0010 is accepted.
